LABEL: UNMATCHED BUDGET — this is a PROBE of the budget axis, not an arm of the registered comparison. It cannot be used to claim H1 or H2.
what: PPO on the edit MDP with the REAL simulator reward (24 rounds / 60 s per evaluation), run for as many real evaluations as the compute ceiling allowed. The registered arms each had 30.
differences_from_the_ppo_arm: terminal_baseline=True with terminal_baseline_source='surrogate' — the registered cause-2 fix (protocol §3.3.1 item 3) at zero simulation cost. Provably an additive per-episode constant, so it cannot change which action sequence is optimal from a given start; it changes only the variance of the advantage across episodes. It therefore cannot make an unlearnable MDP learnable, but a SUCCESS here could not be attributed to budget alone.

surrogate: the GBM rather than the shipped ridge, for shaping, for obs 300/301 and for that baseline. It was chosen on a row-shuffled out-of-fold R2 of 0.492 against ridge's 0.235, and that comparison was NOT out-of-sample: 81 of the 150 dataset rows are 13 mutation families, and holding families out whole scores the GBM +0.071 against ridge's +0.125 — i.e. the GBM comes LAST of the three models, and 86% of its apparent R2 was within-family memorisation. The probe stands as measured; the surrogate it used was picked on a leaked number. Nothing about the probe's VERDICT depends on it (the reward here is real, and the terminal baseline is admissible for any function of the start map, accurate or not), but the shaping term and obs 300/301 were worth less than stated.

SubprocVecEnv workers: 2-3 per seed rather than 5, because the two seeds ran concurrently under a 5-worker ceiling. Fewer envs also means more gradient updates per real evaluation, which at this budget is a difference worth naming.
how_to_read_best_so_far: best_so_far is a running minimum over draws each of which has a standard error of 0.102 (the unpaired SE of a DIFFERENCE of two such draws is 0.144; the per-draw figure is the one that governs a running minimum), so it descends for a policy that never learns. `null_best_so_far` is the bootstrap of exactly that, resampled from each seed's own first 30% of episodes. Read the OBSERVED curve against the NULL, and read `rolling` for the learning signal. Every crossing recorded under `crossover` is a crossing of 0.079, not of 0.000.

surrogate_gap_training_pool.yardstick_note: compare `mean` against `se_of_mean`, NOT against the per-evaluation search SE of 0.102: this is a mean over 139 evaluations and its own SE is smaller by sqrt(139).

crossover.target_is: anneal's REPORT-stage median at 30 real evaluations; the curve below is SEARCH stage, so a crossing here is necessary and not sufficient
crossover.NOT_a_crossing_of_zero: every *_first_eval below is the first evaluation at or below 0.079, NOT at or below 0.000. `*_first_eval_at_zero` is the crossing of 0.000, and the two differ — quoting the 0.079 crossing as 'reaches |err| = 0.000 in N evaluations' is the one prose error this field exists to prevent.
